name: Set-Theoretic Contiguity Obfuscation
description: Removed the explicit coordinate variables (x, y, z) and their linear equations (y-x=p1, z-y=p2). Replaced them with equivalent set-theoretic properties: the union of the two sets must consist of consecutive integers, and all elements of the first set must strictly precede those of the second. This forces the model to logically deduce the total span p1+p2 rather than pattern-matching explicit algebraic bounds.
